notes: The single 'that' of 'that he bestowed' is given to the waw under rule 17 with the object suffix on יַּנִּיחֵם unrepresented (rule 22: two morphemes point at the antecedent, one English word). The competing reading gives 'that' to the object suffix under rule 18's relative-realizing-a-suffix sentence and leaves the waw unrepresented; the waw reading was kept on the analogy of rule 43's אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם → 'that hath a blemish', where the connective morpheme takes the relative and the resumptive suffix goes unrendered.
